deny.an-blurbs:an8.23: plain English — "Hatthaka is anxious to know" is eagerness, not paritassati; a blurb has no Pali to check it against
deny.sn2.17:2.1: utrasta — "Niccaṁ utrastamidaṁ cittaṁ", the mind as terrified, not paritassati
deny.sn2.17:2.5: anutrasta — the negation of sn2.17:2.1's utrasta, same denial
deny.snp5.1:11.1: utrasta — "Utrastaṁ dukkhitaṁ disvā", seeing him terrified, not paritassati
deny.thag16.8:22.4: ubbigga — "ubbiggamanaso", a startled mind; the word this app renders paritassati with, but not that term
